property_summary: For any initialize(...) call the reference contract sets useStolenNftOracle equal to the _useStolenNftOracle argument passed in; the mutant always sets useStolenNftOracle to false, so for some inputs (when _useStolenNftOracle == true) the mutant's post-initialize getter differs from the reference.
change_summary: Replace assignment of useStolenNftOracle to ignore provided _useStolenNftOracle and always set it to false.
